observed_source_contract.comparison: strictly newer packed calendar timestamp from file_get_modify_s
observed_source_contract.cadence: one source step poll per host frame while enabled and file exists
observed_source_contract.delay: run_in(2) creates a global frame-unit time source and starts it

native_profile.authority: only exact paths supplied to successful explicit LoadSource; authored path edits cannot widen this set
native_profile.mtime: floor system filesystem modification time to UTC seconds; source packed-calendar/timezone equality not established
native_profile.clock: monotonic host update counter, independent of timeline tick/seek
native_profile.scheduling: two pending slots suffice for one observation per host frame and a two-frame delay
native_profile.reload: existing bounded ReadImageGraphWavSource and exclusive preview owner retirement; previous decoded source and cached pixels survive decode failure
native_profile.effects: successful reload clears existing preview cache, advances evaluation-input revision, requests preview

open_reference_gates: source callback supplies no path argument to updatePaths(path); behavior in licensed runtime unobserved
source file_datetime_modified_* timezone and exact packed-calendar query parity
